prompt_payload.task: Design a diverse library of executable semantic optimization skills for finite-pool scientific search. Each skill defines interpretable rule features plus a conservative Bayesian linear surrogate blended with strong target-only GP-UCB and GP-EI anchors.

target.title: Matbench experimental band gap replay
target.boundary: Field values and counts are public; target outcomes are not included.

source_transfer_evidence.boundary: Only source outcomes and public source/target descriptors are summarized. No target outcomes are present.

executor.semantic_model: Rules become binary features. Revealed target outcomes fit a ridge Bayesian linear surrogate whose coefficient prior follows rule weights.
executor.anchor: A rank blend of target-only GP-UCB and GP-EI.
executor.fusion: semantic_mass_start/end controls the rank mass assigned to the semantic surrogate; the remaining mass stays on the target-only anchor.
executor.selection: Independent calibration seeds select one frozen skill. Independent held-out seeds are evaluated only after selection.

design_requirements: Use only exact field/value pairs in public_semantic_fields.
Give every skill 3-10 rules; use two-condition interactions only when scientifically meaningful.
Include at least one conservative low-semantic-mass skill.
Include at least one source-evidence skill and one domain-knowledge skill.
Include a counter-hypothesis skill that reverses or downweights an uncertain source relation.
Prefer mechanistic, chemically or physically interpretable rules over arbitrary coverage rules.
Use positive weights for conditions expected to improve the target objective and negative weights for risks.
Do not claim access to target outcomes and do not output candidate identifiers.

rules.rationale: short scientific rationale

skills.hypothesis: what this skill transfers and when it may fail

rules.rationale: Chalcogenides are known to enhance band gap properties.
Avoiding transition metals may lead to higher band gaps.

skills.hypothesis: This skill leverages the positive effects of chalcogenides on band gaps.

rules.rationale: Lanthanides can significantly modify electronic properties.

skills.hypothesis: Lanthanides generally enhance band gap, but effects vary.

rules.rationale: Transition metals may introduce unwanted electronic states.

skills.hypothesis: This skill downweights transition metals due to their uncertain effects.

rules.rationale: Balanced compositions often yield stable properties.

skills.hypothesis: Balanced compositions can enhance band gap stability.

rules.rationale: Lower atomic numbers may favor higher band gaps.

skills.hypothesis: This skill targets materials with lower atomic numbers for better properties.

rules.rationale: Complex compositions can lead to desirable electronic configurations.

skills.hypothesis: Higher element counts can improve band gap properties.

rules.rationale: Halogens may negatively impact band gap in certain contexts.
Metalloids are often beneficial for enhancing band gaps.

skills.hypothesis: This skill utilizes source evidence to guide family selection.

rules.rationale: Heavy elements may lead to undesirable electronic states.

skills.hypothesis: This skill mechanistically addresses the risks of heavy element dominance.
